##### Project general facts

Nesba 1 Aljada by Arada is a contemporary residential building that balances privacy and connectivity with an open, light-filled design. The building rises above a basement parking level, a ground floor and a podium to nine residential floors, combining a refined high-tech style, sustainable materials, clean architectural lines and generous glazing that bring natural light deep into every home. The collection offers one-bedroom apartments and spacious two- and three-bedroom family homes, each with flexible floor plan configurations that adapt easily to different households and changing lifestyles.

Residents enjoy direct access to the flagship sports complex of the community, with a full-size football pitch, five-a-side football fields and dedicated courts for padel tennis, basketball, volleyball and badminton, all set within a landscaped green park. A swimming pool and a fully equipped gym support a healthy routine at home, while communal outdoor spaces encourage activity and social interaction between neighbours. Integrated smart home controls enhance daily convenience and energy efficiency throughout the building.

Every residence features smart home technology as a standard, allowing residents to control lighting, climate and security with ease. Kitchens are fitted with a premium European cooker, an extractor hood and a washer-dryer, while modern finishes and high-quality materials create an elegant, practical backdrop for everyday life. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens only, leaving furniture and decor entirely to the owner's own taste and making every apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah that brings together homes, offices, schools, hotels, retail and leisure within one integrated urban setting. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with parks, a skate park, a drive-in cinema and a wide choice of restaurants, while the tree-lined East Boulevard sits within walking distance with fashionable boutiques, cafes and diverse eateries along a shaded promenade.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Madar and City Centre Al Zahia are a short drive away, University City and Sharjah International Airport are close by, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance for daily commuters and frequent travellers.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the largest mixed-use destinations in Sharjah. Integrated schools, hotels, parks, a business district and extensive sports and leisure facilities attract families, students and young professionals alike. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai and steady tenant demand support attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
